signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Feature ownership: Own the roadmap and backlog for a defined product area, balancing customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities.
Discovery and research: Conduct customer, market, and competitive research to identify problems worth solving, and translate findings into clear recommendations.
Requirements and documentation: Write user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria, and maintain feature documentation and internal knowledge resources.
Customer feedback: Gather and synthesize input from customers, Sales, and Support, and turn it into prioritized product improvements.
Delivery: Work with Engineering, Design, and QA through planning, development, and release. Track progress, manage scope trade-offs, and remove blockers.
Define Product Vision & Differentiation: Establish a clear, compelling product vision and articulate how we uniquely differentiate in the network automation and AI landscape.
Lead AI-Driven Innovation: Develop a strong, opinionated perspective on how Agentic AI should be applied to enterprise networks, translating that into impactful product…
Own the Product Lifecycle: Lead end-to-end product management—from ideation through launch and continuous iteration.
Lead a Global Product Organization: Oversee and mentor a distributed product team across the North America and Beijing, driving alignment, collaboration, and high-quality…
Drive B2B Product Excellence: Build products that address complex enterprise needs, with a deep understanding of B2B buying cycles, stakeholders, and value realization.
